unit.detail: Exact-candidate tcm test step failed only the inherited moving-origin/master T-171 state-schema assertion: 1 failed, 1853 passed, 6 skipped. All T-198 tests passed.

requirements.evidence: Exact-candidate tcm run 36681338277 and its test job concluded failure solely on the inherited moving-origin/master T-171 assertion.
R1 tcm run 36681343536 failed 6 tests: the inherited T-171 assertion and five hub-presence fixture-server tests.
Exact-base tcm run 36681349895 failed only the inherited moving-origin/master T-171 assertion.
Candidate and base have the same sole failure; all five additional r1 hub-presence failures pass on the candidate.
Focused tests inject fetchFn and arm tripwires on global fetch and net.Socket.connect; candidate tcm run passes all T-198 tests under egress isolation.

acceptance.evidence: pollingNow true prints 'grok: listener polling'; the seat-seen mutant dies.
Non-polling fixture prints 'cursor-infra: listener not polling, 3 unread since 5m'.
Unreachable, non-2xx, malformed JSON, timeout, QA 225 rooms-object, negative-unread and null-room cases each produce exactly one visible UNKNOWN line; timeout is bounded.
A partner absent from the roster prints as absent and is not skipped.
The r1 swallow behavior was semantically reapplied to the exact candidate, typechecked, and failed 12 error-contract tests.
Focused presence, greeting-size and server suites pass 67/67; the deterministic presence upper bound is included in greeting-size.
Header and every non-absent partner line explicitly say listener activity and deny proof that the seat read a turn; mutant c60d13a dies on 2 tests.
Every agent and supplied room is structurally validated; seven committed malformed cases and three independent QA cases return one UNKNOWN line; mutant cc114bf dies on 7 tests.
Greeting output reports presence block 313 as a worst-case upper bound, not fetched; the identical-root count is 46139 with and 45825 without; mutant 1419350 dies.
Candidate tcm run 36681338277 passes all five fixture-server tests that fail in r1 run 36681343536; candidate test job failure is only inherited T-171.
Own identity key is sent without output leakage; missing, unreadable and short keys do not call fetch; dev-key and fallback mutants die on 2 and 4 tests.

e_t.notes: QA 230, scoring record 217 r2. The permitted live GET was skipped because this QA account has no cursor-qa2-gpt key. Candidate carries T-196 seat blob 344bd46. G-049 shared checkout identity is reported but is not a T-198 defect. QA mutant 00b29fe is killed by the independent negative-unread probe.
